Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City www.dilq.gov.ph s. 202L OPINION NO DIR. JUAN JOVIAN E. INGENIERO, CESO IV DILG Regional Office VI R Aquino Street, Fort San Pedro Iloilo City Dear Director Ingeniero: This has reference to your letter dated 14 June 2024 seeking the Department's legal opinion and clarifications on Department Circular No. 2016-14 which outlines the "GUIDELINES ON THE AUTHORITY TO PRACTICE PROFESSION AND ACT AS A LECTURER OR RESOURCE PERSON FOR LOCAL GOVERNMENT AND INTERIOR SECTOR OFFICIALS OR EMPLOYEES", specifically Section 8 thereof, to wit: "Officials or employees who are directly invited to conduct lectures or act as resource person on topics which are part of their official functions may receive honorarium, provided that the inviting office is not within the Department. As much as possible, such engagement must be done outside of the regular work hours to ensure that the efficiency of the official or employee in the discharge of his/her duty will not be impaired. In the event that the official or employee is directly invited by other government agencies or private institutions to conduct lectures or act as resource person within office hours, he or she must first secure prior authority from the head of agency or his authorized representative for the said purpose. The time spent in acting as such (lecturer or resource person) must be accordingly deducted from the accrued vacation leave of the concerned official or personnel. However, when the inviting office is part of the Department, the time spent in lectures within office hours shall be considered as "official time". Provided that, the corresponding supporting documents (i.e. certification) shall be attached in the Daily Time Record. xxx."l Per your letter, you seek clarification on the aforementioned guidelines and have raised two questions (rephrased for clarity): 1. Whether or not Circular No. 2016-14 is only applicable to officials or employees who have secured an authority from the Secretary to practice profession; and 2. What inviting offices are considered within the contemplation of "not within the Department" so as the invited official/employee-lecturer would entail deduction Department Circular No. 2016-14. August 22, 2016. "Matino, Mahusay at Maaasahan" Trunkline No. (02) 8876 3454

from the accrued vacation leave when he/she conducts lectures or acts as resource person within office hours? In addressing your first query, we would like to emphasize that Circular No. 2016-14 is not only applicable to employees who have secured an authority from the head of the agency or his authorized representative. It applies to all department officials/employees, in general. The wording of Section 8 of the Circular clearly posits 2 classifications of officials or employees who are directly invited to conduct lectures or act as a resource person: a.) Inviting office is not within the Department b.) Inviting office is within the Department For the first classification employees who are invited by offices not within the Department or by other government agencies or private institution within office hours must first secure prior authority from the head of agency or his authorized representative if the engagement will take place within office hours. The time spent in the engagement shall be deducted from the accrued vacation leave of the official or employee. Per Item 9 of the said Circular, they may receive honorarium if the nature of the speaking engagement is not part of their official function and outside of the regular work hours. For the second classification, employees who will conduct lectures in engagements within the Department shall be considered on "official time". As long as they submit the supporting documents which shall be attached in the Daily Time Record (DTR). With this, it is important to identi first the nature of the speaking engagement in the inviting office. This will indicate the need for compliance regarding securing prior authority and possibility of receiving an honorarium. In this case, receiving honorarium pursuant to Item 9 of the said Circular may apply if the speaking engagement is not directly connected to their official function. To clearly distinguish which offices are considered within the Department, we would like to move on to your second query, and provide you the hereinbelow list for ease of reference: 1. 2. 3. 4. 5. 6. 7. 8. 9. Bureau of Fire Protection Bureau of Jail Management and Penology Local Government Academy National Commission on Muslim Filipinos National Police Commission National Youth Commission Philippine Commission on Women Philippine National Police Philippine Public Safety College Let it be noted that outside of these offices, officials and employees are required to secure a permit from the head of the agency or his authorized representative. The time spent in these engagements that are conducted within office hours will entail a deduction from accrued vacation leave. Page 2 of 3

This opinion shall be without prejudice to any contrary opinion rendered by more competent authorities and/or the courts. We hope to have sufficiently addressed your concern. Thank you. Very truly yours, BY AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: AN s creta R. LLAMAS r External, Legal and Legislative Affairs s JVRULLLS-LRALLD/jkka Page 3 of 3
